Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue May 4, 10:00–11:30
- Wed May 5, 14:00–15:30
- Thu May 6, 08:30–10:00

Prep items we’ll need from Redwood:
- Temporary sandbox API key (or instructions for generating)
- Staging endpoint URL and example curl for auth
- VPC / firewall allowlist IPs to share with infosec
- A short runbook for the routing test cases (can be a Drive link)

We can provision the load test from our side (FinRise QA) but need expected QPS and typical sequence lengths to size clients. I’ve attached our POC order for reference and added a HubSpot deal link below.

Attachments: POC-order.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FR-2027-0921

If you can confirm a slot and the three items above we’ll finalize the invites.

—Aiden

Thanks — adding the technical details so FinRise QA can size the load test and so Hannah has the allowlist items.

Routing lab / load test primer (high level):
- Expected steady-state QPS for the test: 25 qps (2k requests over 90s) — recommend burst windows up to 80 qps for 30s to test autoscaling paths.
- Typical sequence lengths to exercise: 64 tokens (short), 256 tokens (long) — include a mix of temperature=0.2 and 0.8.
- KV cache warmup: we recommend a 10-minute prefix run to populate the KV cache prior to the load window.
- Routing fallbacks: we will intentionally route to a lower-cost compatible model for ~10% of requests to validate correctness and fallback latency.

Example curl (staging, placeholder key):
curl -X POST "https://staging-api.redwood.com/finrise/poc/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Api-Key sandbox-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"<sample prompt>","max_tokens":128}'

I’ve attached a short routing_test_plan.xlsx with the prompt matrix and expected assertions. Marcus

Attachments: routing_test_plan.xlsx
